documentType: Inquiry report — infrastructure-failure investigation (Awatere District Council, Rangitoto Reservoir contamination event, synthetic long-investigation fixture)
canonicalCharCount: ~20,900 extracted chars across 10 pages (pdf-lib-rendered A4 with Helvetica body)
authorshipNote: Synthetic content drafted by Claude Code (bench tranche 2a-ii) as a 10-page Awatere District Council inquiry report. Rendered directly via pdf-lib (not DOCX→PDF) for stable page count. Exercises Phase 4 cross-batch entity propagation (5 named individuals across pages 1-10 in full, honorific, and bare-surname forms) and Phase 3 Example 17 health-safety protective-measures coverage. Closes issue #17. Eugene reviews before commit.
notes: Five named individuals in the parties table (p1-p2): Helen Margaret Ashworth (Commissioner), Dr Tenisha Marama Aalbers (external technical advisor), Gareth Alexander Thornton (former Group Manager — subject of inquiry), Ms Rua Maia Henderson (contractor), Mr Ieremia Hemi Valeafou (council technician witness). Four of the five (all except Ashworth) recur across pages 3-9 in Dr/Mr/Ms + surname AND bare-surname forms — Phase 4 entity propagation targets.

Thornton is a COUNCIL officer but is the subject of an inquiry into his own conduct. Per v3.1 Phase 3 reworded carve-out, officers-in-accountability-context ARE flaggable. Aalbers and Henderson are external third-party professionals — explicitly flaggable per Example 15. Valeafou is a council staff witness and flaggable on the same grounds as other witness-in-investigation patterns.

Health-safety entries use type=health-safety (ground s7(2)(d)): the vulnerability assessment protocol and the emergency backup chlorination procedure. Disclosure of operational details would reveal a vulnerability an adversary could exploit to trigger a contamination event — the Phase 3 Example 17 narrow-reading test.
Free-and-frank uses type=free-frank (ground s7(2)(f)(i)): Inquiry's candid findings on organisational culture and the prior GM's misrepresentation of the 2024 audit.
Legal-privilege uses type=legal-privilege (ground s7(2)(g)): Farrow & Slate's privileged advice on statutory exposure and counsel's settlement range.
Commercial uses type=commercial (ground s7(2)(b)(i)/(ii)): Pacific Flowline's trade-secret proprietary methodology and commercial-in-confidence schedule.

Phase 4 entity-propagation retune (2026-04-23): the name-variant entries (Dr Aalbers, Aalbers, Mr Thornton, Thornton, Ms Henderson, Henderson, Mr Valeafou, Valeafou, plus bare Ashworth) expanded from one no-page entry each into per-page entries matching the canonical pages where each variant actually occurs in the rendered PDF. The pipeline now emits one detection per (variant, page); per-page expected entries align the ground truth with that output. Page distributions were enumerated via pdfjs-dist against the committed B3_Long_Investigation.pdf. See docs/detection-coverage-plan-2026-04.md Phase 4.
